sources.title: Tiny Aya Water model card
sources.evidence: Exact Water card identifies Cohere/Cohere Labs, tiny-aya-it-water, 3.35B, open weights, CC-BY-NC-4.0, text generation, and European/Asia-Pacific specialization. Public card is readable; model files require accepting access conditions.

sources.title: Tiny Aya: Bridging Scale and Multilingual Depth
sources.evidence: March 12, 2026 developer report names Water for Asia-Pacific/Europe. Table 1 distinguishes regional language groups. Section 3.1 describes a dense decoder-only Transformer; Table 2 gives 3.35B total, 36 layers and 8192 input/output tokens. Section 5.4 evaluates prompted chain-of-thought, not a dedicated reasoning API.

sources.title: Tiny Aya documentation
sources.evidence: Exact tiny-aya-water row belongs to the Tiny Aya family, lists 3.35B, and identifies European/Asia-Pacific specialization. Water is an instruction-tuned Chat API variant with downloadable weights.

sources.title: Cohere Labs Launches Tiny Aya, Making Multilingual AI Accessible
sources.evidence: Launch page displays February 17, 2026; its JSON-LD datePublished is 2026-02-17T04:00:07.000-05:00. Embedded article HTML explicitly names TinyAya-Water and its Asia-Pacific/Europe focus. Article body was recovered from the public page HTML because the web text extractor omitted it.

sources.title: Exact Tiny Aya Water repository metadata and chat template
sources.evidence: Public API retrieved directly at repository revision 41a99216d12b3ef4881df762934186e5e4d2bbc1. Exposes Cohere2ForCausalLM, cohere2, base_model tiny-aya-base, license, and one default chat template. Template serializes system/user/assistant/chatbot content; no tools, tool_calls, tool-role handling, thinking branch, or reasoning switch. BF16 aggregate 3349227520 is hosting metadata, not an independently audited learned-tensor count.

sources.title: Tiny Aya Water configuration file access attempt
sources.evidence: Direct unauthenticated retrieval returned HTTP 401 requiring model access and authentication. Full config was not inspected.

sources.title: Tiny Aya Water tokenizer configuration access attempt
sources.evidence: Direct unauthenticated retrieval returned HTTP 401. The exact repository API separately exposes its chat_template; no claim of reading this file directly.

sources.title: An Overview of Cohere Models: Aya table
sources.evidence: Exact tiny-aya-water row specifies text modality, Chat endpoint, 3.35B, and European/Asia-Pacific specialization. The row does not provide reasoning or tool-support capability flags.

sources.title: Basic usage of tool use (function calling)
sources.evidence: Documents Command-family tool use; provides no explicit Tiny Aya Water capability confirmation.

sources.title: Reasoning Capabilities
sources.evidence: Explains dedicated thinking content and switches with Command A Reasoning; does not explicitly establish Tiny Aya Water support or non-support.

name.note: Exact variant name; distinct from Base, Global, Earth and Fire.

developer.note: Card credits Cohere and Cohere Labs.

family.note: Tiny Aya is explicitly a family of five models including Water; normalized catalog key.

release_date.note: Dated developer launch names Water. Earlier repository creation is not treated as public release; March technical report is later evidence.

open_weights.note: Developer distributes weights subject to access conditions and non-commercial license; gated access does not negate open weights.

license.note: Exact repository license metadata; developer additionally requires its acceptable-use policy.

parameters_b.note: Nominal total in billions from exact card and developer report. HF aggregate corroborates rounding only; gated shards were not independently counted.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined active-parameter count. Dense architecture does not justify copying the total.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Transformer with parallel blocks, GQA, SwiGLU, and 3:1 sliding-window/full attention; exact metadata identifies Cohere2ForCausalLM.

context_window.note: Table 2 gives exact input context 8192 tokens; replaces catalog decimal 8000. It also lists output context 8192, which is not added to input context.

modalities.note: Exact API row lists Text; card demonstrates text messages and generated text.

reasoning.note: Exact chat template has no dedicated thinking branch; general prompted reasoning evaluations do not establish a native mode. No explicit model/API negative found, so clear unsupported baseline false.

tool_call.note: Exact template omits tool schemas, tool_calls and tool-role serialization. Chat endpoint availability is insufficient to establish native tool support; hosted API capability remains unverified, so clear baseline true.

description.value: Compact multilingual model specialized for European and Asia-Pacific languages
description.note: Matches exact Water positioning; no unsupported benchmark or general-purpose capability claim.

patch.notes: 3.35B is the developer-reported nominal total. Active parameters are not separately defined. Exact checkpoint metadata exposes an ordinary chat template without native tool or thinking handling; hosted API support for those features remains unverified. Direct configuration and weight access is gated; no independent tensor count was performed.

sources.label: Exact checkpoint metadata and chat template

summary: Verified exact Water identity and February 17 launch. Adds Tiny Aya family, nominal 3.35B total and dense architecture; corrects context from 8000 to 8192. Clears unsupported reasoning=false and tool_call=true to unknown. Active count remains undisclosed; gated tensor files were not independently counted.
